body.statement: If \(\operatorname{rank}(M)<K\), every choice in \(\mathfrak A(M,a,\Lambda,u,\epsilon)\) produces two distinct labeled collections of full-support component laws whose row-wise pooled laws are identical.
body.justification: This supplies a nonboundary necessity witness for the exact rank frontier.
body.gap: Shih--Hero provides the high-level additive transform-inversion precedent but does not state this positive nullspace alias for arbitrary rank-deficient integer compositions.
body.consumer: It shows that replication at unchanged composition rows cannot repair a rank-deficient prospective design.
